```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 6
)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

```{r load_data}
source("../data/basketball_data.R")
```

```{r wrangle}
salary_df  <- as.data.frame(Salary)            |> rownames_to_column("player") |> pivot_longer(-player, names_to = "season", values_to = "salary")
points_df  <- as.data.frame(Points)            |> rownames_to_column("player") |> pivot_longer(-player, names_to = "season", values_to = "points")
games_df   <- as.data.frame(Games)             |> rownames_to_column("player") |> pivot_longer(-player, names_to = "season", values_to = "games")
minutes_df <- as.data.frame(MinutesPlayed)     |> rownames_to_column("player") |> pivot_longer(-player, names_to = "season", values_to = "minutes")
fg_df      <- as.data.frame(FieldGoals)        |> rownames_to_column("player") |> pivot_longer(-player, names_to = "season", values_to = "fg_made")
fga_df     <- as.data.frame(FieldGoalAttempts) |> rownames_to_column("player") |> pivot_longer(-player, names_to = "season", values_to = "fg_attempts")

nba_df <- salary_df |>
  left_join(points_df,  by = c("player", "season")) |>
  left_join(games_df,   by = c("player", "season")) |>
  left_join(minutes_df, by = c("player", "season")) |>
  left_join(fg_df,      by = c("player", "season")) |>
  left_join(fga_df,     by = c("player", "season")) |>
  mutate(
    season          = as.integer(season),
    salary_million  = round(salary / 1e6, 2),
    pts_per_million = ifelse(salary > 0, round(points / (salary / 1e6), 2), NA),
    ppg             = ifelse(games  > 0, round(points / games, 2), NA),
    fg_pct          = ifelse(fg_attempts > 0, round(fg_made / fg_attempts * 100, 2), NA),
    player_clean    = str_replace_all(player, "([A-Z])", " \\1") |> str_trim()
  ) |>
  filter(salary > 0, minutes > 0)
```

```{r scatter_salary_points}
ggplot(nba_df, aes(x = salary_million, y = points, colour = player_clean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "grey40",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format(suffix = "M", prefix = "$")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Salary vs Points Scored (2005–2014)",
    subtitle = "Each point = one player-season. Dashed line = overall trend.",
    x        = "Salary ($ Millions)",
    y        = "Total Points Scored",
    colour   = "Player"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey50"))
```

```{r correlation}
cor_value <- cor(nba_df$salary_million, nba_df$points, use = "complete.obs")
cat("Correlation between salary and points:", round(cor_value, 3), "\n")
```

```{r value_bar}
career_value <- nba_df |>
  filter(!is.na(pts_per_million)) |>
  group_by(player_clean) |>
  summarise(
    avg_pts_per_million = mean(pts_per_million),
    avg_salary_million  = mean(salary_million),
    total_points        = sum(points),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_pts_per_million))

ggplot(career_value,
       aes(x = reorder(player_clean, avg_pts_per_million),
           y = avg_pts_per_million, fill = avg_pts_per_million)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_pts_per_million, 1)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f4a460", high = "#c0392b", guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(career_value$avg_pts_per_million) * 1.15)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Career Average Points Per $1 Million Salary (2005–2014)",
    subtitle = "Higher = better value contract",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Points per $1M"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey50"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

```{r bubble_chart}
avg_salary <- mean(nba_df$salary_million)
avg_points <- mean(nba_df$points)

career_bubble <- nba_df |>
  group_by(player_clean) |>
  summarise(
    avg_salary = mean(salary_million),
    avg_points = mean(points),
    avg_games  = mean(games),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(career_bubble, aes(x = avg_salary, y = avg_points, size = avg_games)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = player_clean), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = avg_points, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = avg_salary, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_text(aes(label = player_clean), vjust = -1, size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 14), name = "Avg Games Played") +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Paired", guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format(suffix = "M", prefix = "$")) +
  annotate("text", x = min(career_bubble$avg_salary) + 0.5,
           y = max(career_bubble$avg_points) - 100,
           label = "High output\nLow salary\n(Best value)", colour = "seagreen", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = max(career_bubble$avg_salary) - 1,
           y = min(career_bubble$avg_points) + 100,
           label = "Low output\nHigh salary\n(Worst value)", colour = "firebrick", size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title    = "Overpaid vs Underpaid — Career Average (2005–2014)",
    subtitle = "Top-left = best value | Bottom-right = worst value",
    x        = "Average Salary ($ Millions)",
    y        = "Average Points Scored"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey50"))
```

```{r salary_growth}
ggplot(nba_df, aes(x = season, y = salary_million, colour = player_clean)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2005:2014) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format(suffix = "M", prefix = "$")) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  labs(
    title    = "Salary Growth by Player (2005–2014)",
    subtitle = "Tracking how contracts evolved across the decade",
    x        = "Season",
    y        = "Salary ($ Millions)",
    colour   = "Player"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey50"))
```

```{r salary_vs_ppg}
ggplot(nba_df, aes(x = salary_million, y = ppg, colour = player_clean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "grey40",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format(suffix = "M", prefix = "$")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Salary vs Points Per Game (2005–2014)",
    subtitle = "Adjusted for games played — a fairer value comparison",
    x        = "Salary ($ Millions)",
    y        = "Points Per Game",
    colour   = "Player"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey50"))
```

```{r summary_table}
nba_df |>
  group_by(player_clean) |>
  summarise(
    total_points        = sum(points),
    avg_salary_million  = round(mean(salary_million), 2),
    avg_ppg             = round(mean(ppg, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    avg_pts_per_million = round(mean(pts_per_million, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_pts_per_million)) |>
  kable(
    caption   = "Career Value Summary — Ranked by Points Per $1M",
    col.names = c("Player", "Total Points", "Avg Salary ($M)",
                  "Avg Pts/Game", "Pts per $1M")
  )
```
